description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'WorkShiftStartAndEndTime' within the OrangeHRM project. The class encapsulates start and end times as DateTime objects, providing constructor, getters, and setters for these properties.

classes.name: WorkShiftStartAndEndTime
classes.description: A DTO class representing start and end times for work shifts, encapsulating DateTime properties with accessor methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance with specified start and end DateTime objects.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the work shift.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time of the work shift.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of the work shift.

methods.name: setEndTime
methods.description: Sets the end time of the work shift.
